title: Gantt Milestone Slip Rate
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:gantt phase_name=* slipped=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(slipped="yes",1,0))) as matched by phase_name
| eval a_slipped_milestone_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_slipped_milestone_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Gantt milestones that end with a slipped milestone by phase.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which phase are helping or hurting Gantt milestones.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a slipped milestone` on `reno:gantt` events and summarize the hit rate by `phase_name`.
visualization: Table of phase with percentage of Gantt milestones ending with a slipped milestone.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how often a slipped milestone happens for each phase so you can see where Gantt milestones go smoothly or get stuck.
